ideas.title: The motor spins its own rope
ideas.nearest: A copper wire keeps its bends
ideas.critique: Yarn whose strength comes from its twist is mechanics the island has never had, and the motor finally does work a person recognises; that breaks the long run of watched devices. But one twist-angle curve for one grass fibre is a rig, and cords are a side errand to the road, not one of its steps.

ideas.title: Read the kiln by its glow
ideas.critique: Glow shifting from red to yellow-white with temperature has now been shown three times (the glass, the hot wire), so the look is expected. What's strong is the judging loop, and potcell.jl already turns each pot's firing into a resistance, so the player's skill carries through into the cart's cells.

ideas.title: Hear the motor strain
ideas.nearest: Chipping a stone to change its note
ideas.critique: A live sound synthesised from the solver's real current and torque, with no sample library, is a new sense for the game and a first in its live play, not just its films. But it gives the player feedback, not a goal, and it sounds like a motor that barely exists yet.

ideas.title: Lay the plank road
ideas.critique: A real puzzle with a new dune every day, with planks that rock and sink and ruts that answer where you left gaps, is the strongest game in the pitch and a part the finished cart will use. Bekker sinkage is already in wheelsand.jl, so the surprise rests on whether the planks and ruts really move.

ideas.title: Cut a sail from palm leaves
ideas.critique: Blade element theory in a gusty wind field, with sails that tear, gives a real trade-off and is a road step. The payoff, though, is once more a wire glowing, which the last post already ended on.

ideas.title: Weigh a friend
ideas.critique: A seesaw and a number is a beach prop with a fact at the end; once you know what a Snootle weighs there is nothing to do twice. Mesh volume times a guessed density is bookkeeping, not a simulation.

ideas.title: Wind the iron stator
ideas.critique: Filings bristling round a coil is the third filings-and-coil picture in a row of magnet posts, so watchers will read it as more of the same. Saturation against heat is a real choice by hand, though, and the stator is the core of the road.

ideas.title: A blue spark in the dark
same_form: A wire that spins by itself
ideas.critique: Again a fixed view of one device switched on and watched; the spark as a light with energy from the coil and pitting that stays on the ring is new, but the shape is the recipe the judge is tired of. It gives the player nothing to do except pull a switch.

ideas.title: Lead plates that fizz
ideas.nearest: A wire that spins by itself
ideas.critique: Traced bubbles rising in glass jars would be a new particle look and a new material showcase, and the accumulator is a road step. A forming law per cycle is easily a fitted curve, and choosing how many cycles to run is thin play until there is wind to charge with and a cart to drive.

ideas.title: Lumi kicks the cart when it stalls
ideas.critique: A body that pushes through its feet with real force, and a sulk that shows, is character work the island needs. But there is no cart yet for it to stall, so the first step will be a staged shove at a box.
